modeling_role: Defines what is inside or outside the model
representation_role: Determines which rows columns relationships states or entities can appear in the matrix
review_warning: Excluded structure cannot be recovered by later computation unless the representation changes

modeling_role: Defines what rows and columns stand for
review_warning: Rows and columns should not be treated as self-explanatory

representation_role: Connects numeric entries to relationships flows probabilities distances or coefficients
review_warning: The same number can mean different things under different representation rules

modeling_role: Defines whether zero means absence measurement missingness thresholding or non-applicability
representation_role: Shapes sparsity distance rank and interpretation
review_warning: Encoding missingness as zero can create false structure

modeling_role: Defines raw units standardization normalization log transformation or other scaling rules
representation_role: Affects comparability conditioning geometry and interpretation
review_warning: Scaling changes what distances coefficients and components mean

modeling_role: Defines the level at which entities time space or categories are represented
representation_role: Controls detail sparsity noise and interpretability
review_warning: Aggregation can hide local variation and distributional structure

modeling_role: Defines how categorical qualitative temporal spatial or relational information becomes numeric
representation_role: Makes information usable in linear algebra
review_warning: Encoding can impose false ordering distance or similarity

modeling_role: Defines what conclusions the representation can and cannot support
representation_role: Prevents computational results from being overclaimed
review_warning: A correct computation can still exceed the evidence allowed by the representation
